info.title: Efir Bot API
info.description: Generated from docs/en/bots/rest.md and objects.md: the Markdown docs are the source; this file is their machine-readable form.

4XX.description: `400` — length or format, `409` — username taken.

username.description: new username: 5–32 characters, Latin letters, digits and `_`, starts with a letter, ends with `_bot`

put.description: Body — the file itself: png, jpg, gif, webp, avif or video mp4, mov; up to 8 MB. Optional header `X-Avatar-Crop: {"x":0,"y":0,"s":1}` (URL-encoded) — the square to display: top-left corner and side as fractions of the image, 0 to 1. Response — user.

4XX.description: `400` — empty file or invalid crop, `413` — larger than 8 MB, `415` — format.

get.description: User profile if the bot shares a server with the user, and these servers in `spaces`.

4XX.description: `404` — no user or shared servers.

get.description: All bot servers, each one — server in full: channels, roles, members, who is in voice.
One server. Errors: `404` — no such server, `403` — bot is not a member.

4XX.description: `404` — no such server, `403` — bot is not a member.

public.description: visible in server search, can join without invite

4XX.description: `404` — invite is invalid or expired, `403` — bot is banned from the server.

code.description: invite code or link containing it, up to 100 characters

get.description: Permission: view audit log. Response — audit log entries, newest first.
About an invite without joining: `{ code, server: { id, name, members, verified } }`. Errors: `404`.

delete.description: Delete: own — always, someone else's — with Manage Server («Управлять сервером») permission.

get.description: Channel and the bot's resulting permissions in it (`permissions`).

patch.description: Permission: manage channels. Response — channel. Send only what you're changing.

slowmode.description: seconds between messages from one member, 0–21600 (6 hours)

user_limit.description: 0–25, 0 — no limit (not more than 25); voice channels only

delete.description: Permission: manage channels. Response — `{ "ok": true }`. Channels of a deleted category remain without a category.

post.description: Permission: manage channels. Response — channel. Server has up to 500 channels.

4XX.description: `400` — name, unknown category, 500 channels already exist.

name.description: 1 to 32 characters; for text channels — lowercase, spaces → `-`

topic.description: topic of text channel, truncated to 1024 characters

patch.description: Order and categories of multiple channels at once. Permission: manage channels. Response — all server channels.

4XX.description: `400` — not a list, unknown channel, invalid category.

put.description: Special permissions for a role or member. Permission: manage roles; can only grant and deny permissions that the bot has. Response — channel.
put.x-permission: manage roles; can only grant and deny permissions that the bot has

4XX.description: `404` — no channel, role or member; `403` — permissions the bot doesn't have.

delete.description: Remove special permissions. Permission: manage roles. Response — channel.

post.description: "Typing…" for 10 seconds. Permission: send messages. Body — `{}`.

get.description: Pinned messages, newest first. Permission: read history.
Messages of the channel, newest at the end. Permission: read history.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: only messages before this time — for paging backwards

post.description: Send message. Permission: send messages (in DM — not needed). Response — message, `201`.

4XX.description: - `403` — no permission to write or attach files; in DM — user blocked the bot or restricted who can message them; - `400` — empty or too long text, someone else's attachment, message to reply to not found; - `429` — message limit or slow mode.

attachments.description: ids of uploaded files, up to 10; extras are dropped

reply_to.description: id of message from this channel: reply with quote

4XX.description: `403` — not the bot's message, `404`.

delete.description: Delete message: own — always, someone else's — with Manage Messages («Управлять сообщениями») permission. Response — `{ "ok": true }`.

put.description: Add reaction. Permission: add reactions. Response — message reactions. `emoji` — one emoji URL-encoded: 👍 → `%F0%9F%91%8D`.

4XX.description: `400` — not an emoji or multiple, `403`, `404`.

delete.description: Remove own reaction. Response — message reactions.

put.description: Pin or unpin. Permission: manage messages. Channel has up to 50 pins. Response — `{ "ok": true }`. Errors: `400` — already 50, `403`, `404`.

delete.description: Pin or unpin. Permission: manage messages. Channel has up to 50 pins. Response — `{ "ok": true }`. Errors: `400` — already 50, `403`, `404`.

post.description: Forward message with attachments. Response — `{ "ids": [...] }`, ids of copies in order of chats.

4XX.description: `400` — not 1–10 chats, forwarding to voice channel or category; `403` — no permission to write or attach files; `404`; `429` — forwarding limit.

channel_ids.description: 1 to 10 chats the bot can write to

comment.description: goes as separate message before copy; truncated to 4000

put.description: Body — the file itself, `Content-Type` any. Permission: attach files. Response — `{ id, name, kind, size }`, `201`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: file name; truncated to 120 characters, `/`, `\` and control characters replaced with `_`

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: width and height of image or video: the app will reserve space

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: width and height of image or video: the app will reserve space

parameters.name: spoiler
parameters.description: image or video under spoiler: blurred until opened

4XX.description: `400` — empty file, `403`, `413` — over limit, `507` — server storage full or disk space running out.

get.description: File content; supports `Range`. Permission: read history in the file's channel. Errors: `404` — no file or deleted, `403`, `416` — invalid `Range`.
get.x-permission: read history in the file's channel

4XX.description: `404` — no file or deleted, `403`, `416` — invalid `Range`.

post.description: Permission: manage roles. New role is placed at the bottom, above `@everyone`. Server has up to 250 roles. Response — role.

hoist.description: show as separate group in member list

patch.description: Role order. Body — `{ "roles": [{ "id", "position" }] }`; higher `position` means higher rank. Errors: `400` — not a list, unknown role, invalid position.

4XX.description: `400` — not a list, unknown role, invalid position.

patch.description: Same fields, all optional. For `@everyone`, only `permissions` change. Response — role. Errors: `403` — role not below bot's highest role or permissions the bot doesn't have; `404`.

4XX.description: `403` — role not below bot's highest role or permissions the bot doesn't have; `404`.

put.description: Grant or revoke role. Permission: manage roles. Response — `{ "roles": [...] }`, member's roles. Errors: `403` — role or member not below bot, `404`.

4XX.description: `403` — role or member not below bot, `404`.

delete.description: Grant or revoke role. Permission: manage roles. Response — `{ "roles": [...] }`, member's roles. Errors: `403` — role or member not below bot, `404`.

4XX.description: `403` — role or member not below bot, `404`.

delete.description: Kick. Permission: kick members. Body — `{ "reason": "…" }` (optional, truncated to 512, goes into audit log). Errors: `403` — owner or member not below bot, `404`.

4XX.description: `403` — owner or member not below bot, `404`.

patch.description: Voice moderation. Response — member's voice state or `{ "ok": true }` if not currently in a voice channel (mute and deafen will take effect when joining).

4XX.description: `400` — moving member not in this server's voice channel; `403` — no permission, member's role not below or no access to channel; `404`.

mute.description: server mute; persists between sessions — mute members

deaf.description: server deafen; persists between sessions — deafen members

get.description: `[{ user_id, user, reason, actor_id, created }]`, newest first.

4XX.description: `400` — the bot itself, `403` — owner or member not below bot, `404`.

delete_message_seconds.description: delete member messages from last N seconds, 0–604800 (7 days)

post.description: Permission: create invites. Response — `{ code, space_id, creator_id, created, expires, max_uses, uses }`, `201`; `expires` — time in ms or `null`, `max_uses` — number or `null`.

max_age.description: seconds to live, 0–2592000 (30 days); 0 — no expiration; default 604800 (7 days)

post.description: Permission: create polls. Response — `{ id, message_id }`.

options.description: 2–10 options, each truncated to 100, no repeats

put.description: Vote. Body — `{ "options": [0, 2] }`: option indices; empty list removes vote. Response — poll.

4XX.description: `400` — poll closed, unknown option, multiple options where only one allowed; `404`.

post.description: Close. Can be done by poll author or member with Manage Messages («Управлять сообщениями») permission. Body — `{}`.
Permission: create events. Response — `{ id, message_id }`.

starts.description: start time, ms; not earlier than a minute ago and not more than 366 days ahead

voice_channel_id.description: voice channel of this server where participants gather

get.description: Profile customization catalog and one item from it (each has `assets[]` with `url`). `404` if the server has no catalog.
Profile customization catalog and one item from it (each has `assets[]` with `url`). `404` if the server has no catalog.

id.description: numeric id padded with zeros to 9 digits

username.description: unique, case-insensitive; case is preserved when displayed

cosmetics.description: profile customization (frame, effect, etc.) if selected

public.description: visible in server search, can join without invite

permissions.description: bot's permissions on server: sum of its roles

voice_states.description: voice states: who is in voice channels now

topic.description: topic of text channel, up to 1024 characters

slowmode.description: seconds between messages from one member, 0 — off

permissions.description: bot's resulting permissions in this channel

bot.description: author is bot; author has verification

verified.description: author is bot; author has verification

text.description: up to 4000 characters, formatting; empty string — attachments only

reply_to.description: id of message this replies to

reply.description: that message: `{ id, channel_id, created, user_id, name, username, text, files }`, first 200 characters of text; `{ id, deleted: true }` if deleted

forward.description: forwarded from: `{ message_id, created, user, server?, channel? }`; for forwarded event or poll it's inside `event` or `poll`

reactions.description: `{ emoji, count, mine }`; `mine` — 1 if bot added this reaction

call.description: a call in a direct chat: `{ id, caller_id, started, answered, ended, duration, state }`; `state` is `ringing`, `active`, `ended`, `missed` or `declined`, `duration` is seconds of talk

width.description: image or video size if provided on upload

height.description: image or video size if provided on upload

url.description: from server root; `null` if file deleted

expired.description: file deleted: no one opened it for 30 days

spoiler.description: image or video with spoiler; absent if not spoiler

variant.description: voice message (`voice`) or round video (`round`) from app; absent for regular files

duration.description: duration in seconds; absent for regular files

waveform.description: 64 bytes of volume in base64; present only for `voice`

user_id.description: who and in which voice channel

channel_id.description: who and in which voice channel

options.description: `{ text, votes }`, 2–10 options; array index — vote number
